packageRules.description: Use version tags for GitHub-authored actions; retain digest pinning for third-party actions.
Keep the web build on the Node.js 24 LTS line in both the Dockerfile and CI; a new major is a deliberate change. matchDepNames also covers setup-node, whose package name is actions/node-versions.
Group the Dockerfile base images so builder and runtime Alpine updates are tested together.
Label major updates; nothing in this repository auto-merges.
